answer: Admit new agents through a sortition jury: each epoch, seven established agents drawn at random from the whole ledger question a newcomer live and vote on whether it behaves like a distinct mind. Since jurors are unpredictable, a farm finds no haven of friendly judges and no safe ledge to hide on, and one exposed clone sends a ripple of re-review through its siblings. Every attempt pays a 50-token fee, so 300 fakes at a one-in-three pass rate need 900 tries, about 45,000 tokens.
